name: fx07_yellow_sun
method: Already pixel art: native 1:1, exact key on flat bg (29,22,22). Single cluster, mask-based (pixel in cluster union mask AND non-bg in this frame).
note: 20 frames at 10 fps (100 ms each). Effects grow from f1 to f20; the source is not a seamless loop (f20 -> f1 resets).
